title.zh: BTCPay Server：热钱包遭未经授权攻击，建议用户暂停运行服务
title.en: BTCPay Server：热钱包遭未经授权攻击，建议用户暂停运行服务

current_state.zh: 调查已识别出影响 2.4.1 及更早版本的攻击向量；团队建议升级至 2.4.7，并称最新版本用户尚无热钱包被盗的可信报告。
current_state.en: The investigation identified an attack vector affecting versions 2.4.1 and earlier; the team advises upgrading to 2.4.7 and says there are no credible reports of hot-wallet theft for users on the latest release.

updates.title_zh: BTCPay Server：热钱包遭未经授权攻击，建议用户暂停运行服务
updates.title_en: BTCPay Server：热钱包遭未经授权攻击，建议用户暂停运行服务
updates.what_changed_zh: BTCPay Server 报告称，攻击者正在未经授权地从在线实例的热钱包中转移资金，并敦促所有运营者在调查结束前关闭服务器。
updates.what_changed_en: BTCPay Server reported that attackers are unauthorizedly moving funds from hot wallets on live instances and urged all operators to shut down their servers until the investigation concludes.
updates.current_state_zh: BTCPay Server 报告称，攻击者正在未经授权地从在线实例的热钱包中转移资金，并敦促所有运营者在调查结束前关闭服务器。
updates.current_state_en: BTCPay Server reported that attackers are unauthorizedly moving funds from hot wallets on live instances and urged all operators to shut down their servers until the investigation concludes.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: BTCPay Server reported that attackers are unauthorizedly moving funds from hot wallets on live instances and urged all operators to shut down their servers until the investigation concludes.
updates.detailed_summary_en: BTCPay Server reported that attackers are unauthorizedly moving funds from hot wallets on live instances and urged all operators to shut down their servers until the investigation concludes.

updates.title_zh: 【BTCPay Server 已识别针对旧版本的攻击向量并提醒用户更新】
updates.title_en: 【BTCPay Server 已识别针对旧版本的攻击向量并提醒用户更新】
updates.what_changed_zh: BTCPay Server 已识别出针对 2.4.1 或更早版本实例的攻击向量，建议用户升级至 2.4.7，并表示尚无运行最新版本的用户热钱包被盗的可信报告。
updates.what_changed_en: BTCPay Server identified an attack vector affecting instances running version 2.4.1 or earlier, advised upgrading to 2.4.7, and said there are no credible reports of hot-wallet theft for users on the latest release.

updates.current_state_en: The investigation identified an attack vector affecting versions 2.4.1 and earlier; the team advises upgrading to 2.4.7 and says there are no credible reports of hot-wallet theft for users on the latest release.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: BTPay Server disclosed an attack vector affecting instances on version 2.4.1 or earlier, urged users to upgrade to 2.4.7, and said no credible reports of hot-wallet theft exist for users on the latest release.
updates.detailed_summary_en: BTPay Server disclosed an attack vector affecting instances on version 2.4.1 or earlier, urged users to upgrade to 2.4.7, and said no credible reports of hot-wallet theft exist for users on the latest release.
